info.description: Protected Control Plane APIs for Layr Platform
info.title: Layr Control Plane API Engine

get.description: Returns active dynamic authentication settings from auth.config including password strength rules, session TTLs, rate limits, MFA policies, and enabled OAuth providers, with client secrets projected as boolean indicators. Requires auth:config.read scope.
get.summary: Retrieve dynamic runtime authentication configuration

put.description: Updates dynamic authentication configuration parameters in auth.config without requiring server restarts. Automatically envelope-encrypts newly supplied third-party OAuth provider secrets with AES-256-GCM using the master encryption key. Requires auth:config.write scope.

get.description: Queries auth.users with pagination, text search over email/phone, role filters, and verification status. Returns user metadata and creation timestamps. Requires auth:user.read scope.

parameters.description: Maximum number of items to return (default 50, maximum 1000)
parameters.name: limit

parameters.description: Number of items to skip before returning results (default 0)
parameters.name: offset

parameters.description: Filter users by role name
parameters.name: role

parameters.description: Case-insensitive substring search matching email or phone number
parameters.name: search

get.summary: List registered application users with filtering and pagination

post.description: Directly provisions a new user record in auth.users with specified email, normalized phone, Argon2id password hash, role, custom properties, and email/phone verification flags. Emits auth.user.created event. Requires auth:user.write scope.
post.summary: Create an application user account via control plane

delete.description: Permanently deletes application user from auth.users, cascading deletion to all active sessions, linked identities, and passkeys. Emits auth.user.deleted event. Requires auth:user.write scope.
delete.summary: Permanently delete an application user and cascade sessions

get.description: Retrieves complete user record from auth.users by UUID, including verification timestamps, role, custom properties JSON, MFA status, lockout metadata, and linked authentication identities. Requires auth:user.read scope.
get.summary: Get detailed application user record by UUID

delete.description: Clears locked_until timestamp in auth.users, restoring authentication capabilities for a user previously locked by control plane action or brute-force protection. Requires auth:user.write scope.
delete.summary: Unlock application user account and restore login access

post.description: Sets locked_until timestamp on auth.users to prevent further authentication, and immediately deletes all active sessions in auth.sessions. Emits auth.user.locked event. Requires auth:user.write scope.
post.summary: Lock application user account and revoke active sessions

get.description: Returns all active sessions from auth.sessions for the specified user ID, detailing client IP, user agent, expiration time, and creation timestamp. Requires auth:user.read scope.
get.summary: List active sessions for an application user

post.description: Deletes all active sessions from auth.sessions for the specified user ID, invalidating all outstanding refresh tokens and forcing re-authentication. Requires auth:user.write scope.
post.summary: Revoke all active sessions for an application user

get.description: Returns active runtime console configuration settings including session duration, MFA enforcement policy, and allowed origins. Requires console:config.read scope.
get.summary: Get dynamic runtime console configuration

put.description: Mutates runtime console configuration parameters in console.config, validating structure and applying settings dynamically across cluster nodes. Requires console:config.write scope.

get.description: Returns all registered console user accounts from console.users with email, active status, MFA enrollment status, last login timestamp, and creation date. Requires console:user.read scope.
get.summary: List console user accounts

post.description: Creates a new console user account in console.users with email and Argon2id password hash (minimum 8 characters). Publishes console.user.created event. Requires console:user.write scope.
post.summary: Create console user account

delete.description: Permanently deletes console user account from console.users, automatically cascading revocation of all active sessions in console.sessions. Emits console.user.deleted event. Requires console:user.write scope.
delete.summary: Delete console user account and cascade sessions

get.description: Retrieves a single console user account from console.users by UUID, including email, enabled status, MFA enrollment flag, and timestamps. Requires console:user.read scope.
get.summary: Get console user account details by UUID

put.description: Modifies email or enabled status of a console user in console.users. If account is disabled, immediately revokes all active sessions in console.sessions. Emits console.user.updated event. Requires console:user.write scope.

post.description: Updates password hash in console.users using Argon2id key derivation and revokes all active sessions in console.sessions, forcing re-login across all devices. Emits console.user.password_reset event. Requires console:user.write scope.
post.summary: Reset console user password and revoke sessions

get.description: Returns all active sessions from console.sessions for the specified console user, including client IP address, user-agent string, creation timestamp, and expiration time. Requires console:user.read scope.
get.summary: List active sessions for a console user

post.description: Terminates all active sessions in console.sessions for the specified console user, immediately invalidating cookie tokens. Emits console.user.sessions.revoked_all event. Requires console:user.write scope.
post.summary: Revoke all active sessions for a console user

delete.description: Terminates a single session by session UUID from console.sessions for the specified console user. Emits console.user.session.revoked event. Requires console:user.write scope.
delete.summary: Revoke a specific console user session

get.description: Lists event hook subscriptions from core.event_hooks with driver (sql or http), target function or URL, subscribed event type patterns, retry limits, and enabled status. Requires core:event-hook.read scope.

parameters.description: Filter event hooks by delivery driver ('sql' or 'http')
parameters.name: driver

parameters.description: Filter event hooks by active enabled status
parameters.name: is_enabled

get.summary: List event hook subscriptions

post.description: Creates an event hook subscription in core.event_hooks for SQL stored procedures (sql driver) or HTTP webhooks (http driver) with HMAC-SHA256 signing secret encryption, wildcard event patterns, timeout guards, and retry policies. Requires core:event-hook.write scope.
post.summary: Create an event hook subscription

delete.description: Permanently removes an event hook subscription from core.event_hooks, immediately unbinding event dispatches. Delivery history is preserved or cascaded according to retention rules. Requires core:event-hook.write scope.

get.description: Retrieves event hook configuration by UUID from core.event_hooks, including driver type, target endpoint, subscribed event patterns, retry limits, and secret configuration indicator. Requires core:event-hook.read scope.
get.summary: Get event hook subscription details by UUID

put.description: Modifies event hook parameters in core.event_hooks including target URL or stored procedure, subscribed event patterns, retry count (0-10), timeout (1-60s), signing secret, or enabled status. Requires core:event-hook.write scope.

get.description: Queries the 100 most recent dispatch attempts for an event hook from core.event_hook_deliveries, detailing event ID, payload, HTTP status code, duration in milliseconds, error messages, and delivery state. Requires core:event-hook.read scope.
get.summary: List delivery audit logs for an event hook

post.description: Manually redrives an event hook delivery using the recorded event payload, re-dispatching via the configured driver (SQL procedure or HTTP POST webhook) and recording the new attempt outcome. Requires core:event-hook.write scope.
post.summary: Retry a past event hook delivery attempt

get.description: Queries immutable system and domain events from core.events with multi-field filtering by event type, actor type, date ranges, and pagination limits. Returns full event context, actor, and payload data. Requires core:event.read scope.

parameters.description: Maximum number of items to return (default 50, maximum 1000)
parameters.name: limit

parameters.description: Number of items to skip before returning results (default 0)
parameters.name: offset

parameters.description: Filter by specific event type name
parameters.name: type

parameters.description: Filter by actor principal type (user, service_account, system)
parameters.name: actor_type

parameters.description: Filter by actor principal UUID
parameters.name: actor_id

parameters.description: Filter by target resource entity type
parameters.name: resource_type

parameters.description: Filter by target resource unique identifier
parameters.name: resource_id

get.summary: Query immutable system and domain audit events

get.description: Retrieves a specific canonical event record by UUID from core.events, including event type, actor principal, transport context (IP, user agent, request ID), and structured payload data. Requires core:event.read scope.
get.summary: Get individual event record by UUID

get.description: Lists all machine service accounts from core.service_accounts with name, key prefix, granted permission scopes, enabled status, IP allowlists, and expiration timestamps. Requires core:service-account.read scope.
get.summary: List machine service accounts

post.description: Creates a machine service account, generates a high-entropy 32-byte hex secret key, hashes it with SHA-256 for storage in core.service_accounts, and returns the plaintext secret key once. Supports scope constraints and CIDR IP restrictions. Requires core:service-account.write scope.
post.summary: Create a machine service account

delete.description: Deletes a machine service account from core.service_accounts. Enforces strict safety invariants: prevents deleting accounts owned by console users and ensures at least one active root account remains. Requires core:service-account.write scope.

get.description: Retrieves a machine service account by UUID from core.service_accounts, returning metadata, permission scopes, key prefix, and allowed IP patterns. Plaintext key is not recoverable. Requires core:service-account.read scope.
get.summary: Get machine service account details by UUID

put.description: Modifies name, description, permission scopes, IP allowlist, or enabled status in core.service_accounts. Enforces safety invariant that at least one enabled root account with wildcard * scope remains. Requires core:service-account.write scope.
put.summary: Update machine service account properties and scopes

post.description: Flushes in-memory and distributed table reflection metadata, query result caches, and composite version counters across all cluster nodes. Requires data:cache.write scope.
post.summary: Flush all global query and schema reflection caches

post.description: Invalidates schema reflection and query caches for a specific schema, table name, or pattern, bumping composite table cache versions. Requires data:cache.write scope.
post.summary: Invalidate specific table or catalog caches

get.description: Returns dynamic data service configuration settings including exposed schema names, connection pool sizes, REST limit defaults, and cache TTL parameters. Requires data:config.read scope.
get.summary: Retrieve dynamic data service configuration

put.description: Updates operational data service parameters in data.config, dynamically tuning connection limits, exposed schemas, and cache behaviors without server downtime. Requires data:config.write scope.

get.description: Queries PostgreSQL information_schema and pg_catalog to return tables, primary key column names, approximate row counts, and RLS enabled statuses across exposed schemas. Requires data:schema.read scope.
get.summary: List all database tables across configured schemas

post.description: Executes DDL to provision a table adhering to Layr conventions (UUIDv7 primary keys, created_at, and last_updated_at timestamps), invalidating catalog caches and emitting data.table.created event. Requires data:schema.write scope.
post.summary: Create a new PostgreSQL table with UUIDv7 primary key

delete.description: Executes DROP TABLE CASCADE in PostgreSQL, removing the table, associated indexes, triggers, and foreign key constraints. Invalidates catalog caches and emits data.table.deleted event. Requires data:schema.write scope.

parameters.description: Cascade table drop to dependent constraints and views
parameters.name: cascade

delete.summary: Drop a table and cascade constraints

get.description: Retrieves complete architectural schema for a table, detailing columns (types, nullability, defaults), primary/foreign key constraints, indexes, and active RLS policies. Requires data:schema.read scope.
get.summary: Inspect table schema, columns, indexes, and constraints

post.description: Executes ALTER TABLE ADD COLUMN with validated PostgreSQL data type, nullability constraint, and optional default expression. Invalidates schema reflection caches and emits data.table.updated event. Requires data:schema.write scope.
post.summary: Add a new column to a table schema

delete.description: Executes ALTER TABLE DROP COLUMN CASCADE, dropping the column and dependent views or indexes. Invalidates reflection caches and emits data.table.updated event. Requires data:schema.write scope.

parameters.description: Cascade column drop to dependent views or indexes
parameters.name: cascade

delete.summary: Drop a column from a table schema

patch.description: Alters column attributes (data type conversion, set/drop default, set/drop NOT NULL) or renames the column. Invalidates table metadata caches and emits data.table.updated event. Requires data:schema.write scope.
patch.summary: Alter column type, default, nullability, or rename

get.description: Queries pg_indexes to return all index definitions, methods, uniqueness constraints, and column lists for the specified table. Requires data:schema.read scope.
get.summary: List indexes defined on a table

post.description: Executes CREATE INDEX supporting B-Tree, GIN, GiST, or BRIN index methods, unique constraints, and multi-column expressions. Emits data.table.updated event. Requires data:schema.write scope.
post.summary: Create an index on table columns

delete.description: Executes DROP INDEX in PostgreSQL, removing the index and invalidating query planner metadata. Emits data.table.updated event. Requires data:schema.write scope.
delete.summary: Drop an index from a table

get.description: Queries pg_policies to list active Row-Level Security (RLS) policies, detailing command targets (SELECT, INSERT, UPDATE, DELETE), roles, USING filters, and WITH CHECK expressions. Requires data:schema.read scope.
get.summary: List Row-Level Security policies on a table

post.description: Executes CREATE POLICY in PostgreSQL, attaching declarative row-level access control rules for specific database roles and SQL commands with USING and WITH CHECK expressions. Emits data.table.updated event. Requires data:schema.write scope.
post.summary: Create a Row-Level Security policy on a table

delete.description: Executes DROP POLICY on the specified table, removing the security policy from PostgreSQL enforcement. Emits data.table.updated event. Requires data:schema.write scope.
delete.summary: Drop an RLS policy from a table

patch.description: Executes ALTER TABLE to ENABLE, DISABLE, or FORCE Row-Level Security (RLS) enforcement on the table. Invalidates table metadata and emits data.table.updated event. Requires data:schema.write scope.

parameters.description: RLS enforcement mode ('ENABLE', 'DISABLE', or 'FORCE')
parameters.name: action

parameters.description: Whether to enforce RLS for table owners when action is FORCE
parameters.name: force

patch.summary: Toggle Row-Level Security enforcement mode on a table

get.description: Returns all configured storage buckets from file_storage.buckets, detailing backend type (database or s3), public access flag, file size limits, and allowed MIME types. Requires storage:bucket.read scope.
get.summary: List all storage buckets and backend configurations

post.description: Provisions a new storage bucket in file_storage.buckets with database or S3 backend settings, size limits, allowed MIME types, and public access policy. Emits file_storage.bucket.created event. Requires storage:bucket.write scope.
post.summary: Create a storage bucket with backend configuration

delete.description: Deletes a storage bucket from file_storage.buckets and permanently cascades deletion of all stored objects from the backend and database. Emits file_storage.bucket.deleted event. Requires storage:bucket.write scope.
delete.summary: Delete a storage bucket and cascade contained objects

get.description: Retrieves configuration, size limits, allowed MIME types, backend type, and public access status for a specific bucket from file_storage.buckets. Requires storage:bucket.read scope.
get.summary: Get storage bucket details by name

patch.description: Modifies bucket settings in file_storage.buckets including public flag, file size limit, allowed MIME types, and backend configuration. Emits file_storage.bucket.updated event. Requires storage:bucket.write scope.
patch.summary: Update storage bucket configuration and constraints

get.description: Queries metadata records in file_storage.objects for the specified bucket, detailing key paths, file sizes, MIME types, ETags, and upload timestamps with pagination. Requires storage:bucket.read scope.

parameters.description: Maximum number of items to return (default 50, maximum 1000)
parameters.name: limit

parameters.description: Number of items to skip before returning results (default 0)
parameters.name: offset

get.summary: List objects stored within a bucket

get.description: Returns dynamic operational configuration settings for the file storage subsystem including global size limits and default backends. Requires storage:config.read scope.
get.summary: Get runtime file storage configuration

put.description: Updates dynamic operational configuration for the file storage subsystem in storage.config, tuning global upload limits and backends without restart. Requires storage:config.write scope.

get.description: Returns operational function runtime settings including default isolate timeouts, memory limits, runner concurrency, and isolate pool capacities. Requires function:config.read scope.
get.summary: Get runtime function configuration

put.description: Modifies operational function runtime settings in function.config, tuning concurrency limits, memory caps, and execution timeouts without restarting the gateway. Requires function:config.write scope.

get.description: Returns all registered custom domain definitions from function.custom_domains with hostnames and verification states. Requires function:endpoint.read scope.
get.summary: List registered custom domains

post.description: Registers a standalone custom domain hostname in function.custom_domains with verification status and TLS configuration. Emits function.domain.created event. Requires function:endpoint.write scope.
post.summary: Register a standalone custom domain

delete.description: Deletes a custom domain from function.custom_domains, cascading removal of all attached endpoint route mappings. Emits function.domain.deleted event. Requires function:endpoint.write scope.
delete.summary: Delete custom domain and cascade attached routes

get.description: Returns all registered serverless endpoints from function.endpoints with route names, runtime engines, timeout guards, memory limits, active deployment IDs, and status. Requires function:endpoint.read scope.
get.summary: List all registered serverless endpoints

post.description: Provisions a new serverless endpoint definition in function.endpoints with route path, name, runtime environment (Node, Deno, Python, Go), timeout guards, memory limits, and environment variables. Emits function.endpoint.created event. Requires function:endpoint.write scope.
post.summary: Register a new serverless endpoint

delete.description: Permanently deletes an endpoint from function.endpoints, unloads running worker isolates, cascades historical deployments, and removes custom domain routes. Emits function.endpoint.deleted event. Requires function:endpoint.write scope.
delete.summary: Delete serverless endpoint and unload runtime isolates

get.description: Retrieves complete definition of a serverless endpoint from function.endpoints by ID or name, including runtime configuration, environment variables, and active deployment version. Requires function:endpoint.read scope.
get.summary: Get serverless endpoint definition by ID

put.description: Modifies an existing serverless endpoint definition in function.endpoints, updating environment variables, timeout guards, or memory limits. Emits function.endpoint.updated event. Requires function:endpoint.write scope.

post.description: Uploads and registers an immutable code bundle in function.deployments, increments revision version, sets it as the active deployment pointer, and immediately hot-reloads runtime worker isolates. Emits function.deployment.created event. Requires function:endpoint.deploy scope.
post.summary: Create immutable deployment and hot-reload runner

get.description: Returns version history of immutable code deployments for an endpoint from function.deployments, detailing revision numbers, creation timestamps, and active flags. Requires function:endpoint.read scope.
get.summary: List immutable deployments for an endpoint

get.description: Returns all custom domain route mappings from function.custom_domain_routes configured for a specific serverless endpoint. Requires function:endpoint.read scope.
get.summary: List custom domain routes attached to an endpoint

post.description: Maps a custom domain hostname and URL path prefix to a specific serverless endpoint in function.custom_domain_routes, enabling custom domain routing. Requires function:endpoint.write scope.
post.summary: Attach endpoint route to custom domain with path prefix

delete.description: Removes a specific domain route mapping from function.custom_domain_routes, unbinding the custom path prefix from the endpoint. Requires function:endpoint.write scope.
delete.summary: Remove endpoint route mapping from custom domain

get.description: Returns historical invocation audit records from function.executions for a specific endpoint, detailing response codes, durations, memory usage, and execution log streams. Requires function:endpoint.read scope.

parameters.description: Maximum number of items to return (default 50, maximum 1000)
parameters.name: limit

parameters.description: Number of items to skip before returning results (default 0)
parameters.name: offset

get.summary: Query execution history logs for a specific endpoint

post.description: Atomically updates the active deployment pointer in function.endpoints to an earlier immutable deployment version, instantly hot-reloading runtime runner isolates. Emits function.deployment.rollback event. Requires function:endpoint.deploy scope.
post.summary: Rollback endpoint to a previous deployment revision

get.description: Queries execution telemetry logs from function.executions across all endpoints, returning status codes, execution duration in milliseconds, memory utilization, and stdout/stderr streams. Requires function:endpoint.read scope.

parameters.description: Maximum number of items to return (default 50, maximum 1000)
parameters.name: limit

parameters.description: Number of items to skip before returning results (default 0)
parameters.name: offset

parameters.description: Filter executions by endpoint UUID
parameters.name: endpoint_id

get.summary: Query execution history logs across all endpoints

get.description: Returns real-time runtime statistics including active worker isolates count, memory consumption, runner queue depth, and throughput metrics. Requires function:stats.read scope.
get.summary: Get function runtime telemetry and worker statistics

get.description: Returns operational image service settings including compression quality defaults, maximum resolution limits, allowed source domains, and signature enforcement policy. Requires image:config.read scope.
get.summary: Get runtime image service configuration

put.description: Modifies operational image service parameters in image.config, updating compression quality, resolution limits, and domain allowlists without restarting the service. Requires image:config.write scope.

get.description: Returns all configured transformation presets from image.presets with preset names, processing option strings, and creation timestamps. Requires image:preset.read scope.
get.summary: List configured image transformation presets

post.description: Creates a new transformation preset in image.presets defining reusable imgproxy processing options (dimensions, crop mode, quality, format). Emits image.preset.created event. Requires image:preset.write scope.
post.summary: Create a named image transformation preset

delete.description: Deletes a transformation preset by ID from image.presets. Emits image.preset.deleted event. Requires image:preset.write scope.

get.description: Retrieves a single transformation preset definition by ID from image.presets. Requires image:preset.read scope.
get.summary: Get image transformation preset by ID

put.description: Modifies the transformation options or friendly name of an existing preset in image.presets. Emits image.preset.updated event. Requires image:preset.write scope.

get.description: Returns real-time operational statistics including image cache hit ratios, processing latency, memory usage, and transformation throughput. Requires image:stats.read scope.
get.summary: Get image service telemetry statistics

post.description: Generates a cryptographically signed HMAC-SHA256 signature and URL path for an image transformation request using the master image key. Requires image:sign.write scope.
post.summary: Generate a cryptographically signed image URL

get.description: Returns operational task configuration settings including worker concurrency limits, poller interval, default timeout guards, and exponential retry backoff parameters. Requires tasks:config.read scope.
get.summary: Get runtime tasks orchestrator configuration

put.description: Updates operational task configuration in tasks.config, dynamically adjusting worker concurrency, polling intervals, and retry backoff limits without restarting workers. Requires tasks:config.write scope.

get.description: Queries dead-lettered executions from tasks.executions that exhausted all configured retry attempts, detailing failure errors, stack traces, and attempt counts. Requires tasks:execution.read scope.

parameters.description: Maximum number of items to return (default 50, maximum 1000)
parameters.name: limit

parameters.description: Number of items to skip before returning results (default 0)
parameters.name: offset

get.summary: List dead-lettered failed task executions

delete.description: Permanently removes a failed execution record from tasks.executions / dead-letter queue. Requires tasks:execution.write scope.
delete.summary: Permanently purge a failed task from the DLQ

post.description: Resets a dead-lettered execution in tasks.executions to 'pending' status for immediate worker retry pickup. Requires tasks:execution.write scope.
post.summary: Re-queue a failed task execution from the DLQ

get.description: Queries execution history records from tasks.executions with filtering by job ID, execution status (pending, running, completed, failed, dead_lettered), duration, and date ranges. Requires tasks:execution.read scope.

parameters.description: Maximum number of items to return (default 50, maximum 1000)
parameters.name: limit

parameters.description: Number of items to skip before returning results (default 0)
parameters.name: offset

parameters.description: Filter task executions by job UUID
parameters.name: job_id

get.summary: Query execution audit logs

post.description: Manually enqueues an execution for a job in tasks.executions with status 'pending' for immediate worker dispatch out-of-schedule. Requires tasks:execution.write scope.
post.summary: Trigger an immediate out-of-schedule execution

get.description: Returns all registered recurring cron jobs from tasks.jobs, detailing cron schedule expressions, target drivers (http, function, sql), target payloads, timezone, next execution countdowns, and active status. Requires tasks:job.read scope.
get.summary: List all recurring cron jobs

post.description: Creates a recurring cron job in tasks.jobs with 5-field cron expression, target execution driver (http webhook, serverless function, or SQL stored procedure), payload JSON, timeout guards, retry limits, and timezone. Calculates next run timestamp and emits tasks.job.created event. Requires tasks:job.write scope.
post.summary: Register a new recurring cron job

delete.description: Deletes a cron job definition from tasks.jobs and cancels any associated pending executions in tasks.executions. Emits tasks.job.deleted event. Requires tasks:job.write scope.
delete.summary: Delete a cron job and cancel queued executions

get.description: Retrieves a single cron job definition from tasks.jobs by ID, including cron expression, target payload, execution driver, next run countdown, and status. Requires tasks:job.read scope.
get.summary: Get cron job definition by ID

patch.description: Modifies cron schedule expressions, timezone, target payloads, retry parameters, or active status in tasks.jobs. Recalculates next run timestamp and emits tasks.job.updated event. Requires tasks:job.write scope.
patch.summary: Update an existing cron job definition

get.description: Returns real-time task statistics including total job counts, active queue depth, currently running executions, DLQ size, and execution success rate. Requires tasks:stats.read scope.
get.summary: Get operational task telemetry and queue statistics
